title: Squash Fritters French-Style
description: A crispy French-inspired fritter dish made with roasted squash and a nutty twist.
instructions: 2. In a bowl, mix together squash, flour, egg whites, almonds, and salt.
3. Using a spoon, drop small amounts of the mixture into the hot fry oil.
4. Fry until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes.
5. Using a slotted spoon, remove the fritters from the oil and place on a paper towel-lined plate.
6. Serve warm, garnished with additional almonds if desired.
